channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: Max uint256 Token Approvals and What They Allow
item.description: What does max uint256 mean in a token approval? It is the largest ERC-20 allowance, letting a spender move any amount of that token you hold, now or later.

item.title: Why Is My Bridged ETH Balance Smaller After Gas?
item.description: Amount received after bridging can be lower because Ethereum gas comes from your wallet balance, while route fees or swaps can change the amount delivered.

item.title: Coinbase USDC: Base or Ethereum before bridging?
item.description: Withdraw USDC from Coinbase on Base or Ethereum before bridging: Base usually costs less, while Ethereum suits a mainnet destination or a route with limited options.

item.title: How to Track a Solana Token Creator Wallet Through Its History
item.description: Learn how to track a Solana token creator wallet: find the exact mint, inspect its creation transaction, compare wallet roles and review on-chain history.

item.title: How to Pick a MetaMask Gas Preset and Clear a Stuck Transaction
item.description: MetaMask gas setting low vs market vs aggressive: use Market for most transactions, Low when you can wait and Aggressive when timing matters; learn how to speed up a stuck transaction.

item.title: How to Resend a Solana Transaction After Blockhash Expiry
item.description: Solana transaction failed with “blockhash not found”? Fetch a fresh blockhash, re-sign, and resend before lastValidBlockHeight; match commitment across RPC calls.

item.title: Rebasing tokens vs share-based vault tokens: where yield shows
item.description: Rebasing tokens vs share-based vault tokens difference: rebasing raises your balance; share tokens keep it steady while each share claims more assets.

item.title: How to unstake when Aave is down and get tokens back
item.description: Aave app vs Etherscan for unstaking: wait while your window has days left; use a verified contract call if it closes within a day to redeem your stake.

item.title: My vault shares rose 5%: when the gain is taxed
item.description: How DeFi lending vault earnings are taxed: rewards count as income when you control them; share-price gains usually count when you redeem or sell your shares.

item.title: Ethereum transaction nonces and transaction order
item.description: A transaction nonce in Ethereum is an account’s next number in sequence. Learn how it orders transactions, blocks later sends and helps replace a stuck one.

item.title: Brale takes custom stablecoin issuance live on Cardano
item.description: Brale has opened Cardano to custom USD stablecoin issuance on mainnet and testnet, giving businesses a new route for payments, payouts and treasury use.

item.title: Block.coinbase in Solidity: Who Sets the Fee Recipient
item.description: What does block.coinbase return in a smart contract? The current block’s payable fee-recipient address, which builders can receive through conditional payments.

item.title: Polling vs webhooks: how should a trading bot refresh token risk?
item.description: For token risk updates in a trading bot, use events to trigger a fetch, then refresh the report before each order. Poll only a small watchlist to save calls.

item.title: How Do You Calculate Net DEX Swap Output Tokens?
item.description: To calculate the net amount received from a DEX swap, total output-token transfers into your wallet and subtract same-token transfers out; record gas separately.

item.title: Blind Signing vs Clear Signing: What the Prompt Shows
item.description: Blind signing vs clear signing comes down to what your wallet displays: raw data or readable transaction fields you can review before approval on screen.

item.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete digital gold trades
item.description: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX tested digital claims on London gold bars, settling trades and using the interests as collateral in a first for wholesale markets.

item.title: Why One SyncSwap Swap Creates Multiple Transfer Rows
item.description: Why does my swap show several token transfers on the explorer? Each row logs a step; filter for your address to find the trade’s net input and output.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russia-linked crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission has proposed new Russia sanctions covering crypto networks and 60 banks, with approval still needed from all 27 EU states.

item.title: Can anyone submit Bitcoin headers to a bridge relay?
item.description: Can anyone run a relayer for a Bitcoin bridge? Yes, when the relay contract checks proof of work and chain links; the main cost is destination-chain gas.

item.title: Circulating supply vs total supply: What each figure means
item.description: Circulating supply vs total supply in crypto: total counts minted tokens minus burns; circulating counts the share available to trade, leaving locked tokens out.
